title: Rebuild release freeze derived-evidence corrective
rawUserRequest: Continue the authorized release plan; fix any discovered process root cause before publication.

declaredIntent.summary: Rebuild the release-freeze derived-evidence correction on a clean branch because the prior local archive exposed Ruff defects after archive and must remain immutable and unmerged.

outOfScope: Creating or changing tags, Releases, assets, release metadata projections, or provider workflows.

riskAssessment.reason: Freeze evidence must bind exact archive bytes before immutable provider publication.

executionDecision.reason: User authorized continuous corrective execution without gate bypass.

preReviewWarnings: Review controlled worktree archive binding, the no-self-reference boundary, and locked Ruff compliance before archive.

checkpointPolicy.reason: Bind release evidence ordering and prevent recurrence of the post-archive lint defect.

acceptance: Regression tests prove controlled dirty tracked evidence is included in the final worktree archive and that finalization refreshes it before binding.
Capability Truth does not hash export-ignored release metadata that contains its own archive identity.
Finalizer refreshes Capability Truth, Japanese assessment, and documentation alignment before canonical archive calculation.
The successor passes locked Ruff checks before archive and check-ai-pr after archive but before push.
No provider tag, Release, asset, or publication is created.
guidelines: Use controlled generators rather than manual evidence edits.
Keep provider publication outside this corrective.
Archive only lint-clean code so immutable Work Item evidence is reviewable.

intent.problem: Release finalization calculated sourceTree and archiveSha256 from the committed candidate before it regenerated Capability Truth. The subsequent Japanese assessment and documentation-alignment generators changed archive-included evidence. An archive-included Capability Truth row also hashed export-ignored release.json, which contains archiveSha256, creating a self-reference that cannot converge. The initial corrective correctly found this root cause but its archive must remain immutable after locked Ruff later found import-order defects before PR creation.
constraints: Generate only controlled, tracked derived reports before archive binding and fail closed if an unexpected tracked path changes.
Archive-included evidence must not hash export-ignored metadata that contains its own archive identity.
Keep release.json, release-state.json, release-freeze.json, and release-digests.json export-ignored and do not weaken release preflight validation.
Do not create provider tags, Releases, assets, or workflow-side publication during this corrective.
Use the temporary user-authorized focused local verification policy; Hosted PR remains mandatory.
intent.rationale: Rebuilding from current origin/main makes the lint repair part of the immutable Work Item lifecycle. Serializing controlled worktree content after generators run, while removing the self-reference, prevents stale archive evidence and preserves the independent post-merge preflight check.

verification.reason: Temporary user-authorized efficiency exception; focused tests and Hosted PR remain mandatory.

rollbackNote: Revert this corrective Work Item through its dedicated PR; no provider-side release state is created by this Work Item.
